assessments.summary: The abstract Boolean formulation is sound and complete for the stated rct4 subclass. The non-anti-diagonal selectable cells partition into disjoint four-cell rho-orbits off both diagonals and 38 antipodal main-diagonal pairs. Selecting exactly 38 orbit variables and one diagonal-pair variable yields 154 points with precisely the required subclass structure, while every 154-point subclass member uniquely determines such selections. For every maximal lattice line L, the weighted sum equals the exact number of selected points on L, so imposing it at most 2 is equivalent to forbidding collinear triples. The report's noted overbroad README sentence about every unconstrained Boolean assignment is false but is not part of, and does not undermine, the declared theorem concerning satisfying assignments.
scopeQualifications: The result is only a bijection between satisfying assignments of the stated abstract system and 154-point no-three-in-line members of the explicitly defined rct4 subclass.
It makes no assertion about satisfiability or infeasibility, implementation-specific constraint counts or digests, larger symmetry classes, rotation classifications, or D(77).
